# Elaine Millar

Elaine Millar is the current Deputy of [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Elaine Millar has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/elaine-millar#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 3 with 59% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/elaine-millar/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G_OtQh93w_4)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220820132330/https://www.elainemillar.je/)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Elaine-Millar-Deputy-St-John-St-Lawrence-and-Trinty-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=18)

Elaine Millar has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2025/12/01/treasury-minister-to-stand-as-senator-in-2026-election/)\]
